summary: This joint resolution nullifies the EPA rule titled 'Air Plan Approval; Ohio; Withdrawal of Technical Amendment' (90 Fed. Reg. 6811) by declaring it has no force or effect under the Congressional Review Act.

The bill uses the Congressional Review Act to disapprove an EPA rule titled 'Air Plan Approval; Ohio; Withdrawal of Technical Amendment' (90 Fed. Reg. 6811). This directly intervenes in EPA air-quality regulation under the Clean Air Act, which falls under environmental policy. The action is intended to nullify an EPA administrative step on Ohio's state implementation plan, thereby limiting the effect of that EPA action and aligning with efforts to constrain federal environmental regulations.
